gpu_profiling_limits.torch: Matched diagnostic traces contain CPU events only, with no GPU kernel events.
gpu_profiling_limits.rocprof_attach: Attempts in rocprof-reference and rocprof-v2-reference failed because the running SDK exposes no rocp-bg-attach thread, including when started with ROCP_TOOL_ATTACH=1.
gpu_profiling_limits.rocprof_startup: rocprof-v3-reference started with selected-regions and ROCTx. Its unprofiled warmup completed 128 outputs in3.364s; collection subsequently ran at approximately0.3outputs/s. The agent interrupted this heavily perturbed probe. SDK signal handling then recursed during shutdown, requiring termination of that owned process group. No usable CSV trace was produced and no analytical profiling case was run.
gpu_profiling_limits.attribution: These profiling failures do not identify the cause of the earlier unprofiled TP2 regression. Existing ROCTx kernel cliff profiles and exact executed ISA audits remain separate valid evidence.
